name: Webcrome Neon Sign Customizer for WooCommerce
author: Webcrome Software

sections.description:
Webcrome Neon Sign Customizer lets your customers design custom neon signs with a live glowing preview directly on your WooCommerce product page.

Free Features

  • Real-time neon glow preview with authentic flicker animation
  • 6 neon colors with true glow effect
  • 4 Google Fonts with live preview
  • Dynamic pricing — price updates live as customer types
  • WooCommerce cart integration
  • Mobile responsive

Pro Features

Upgrade at webcrome.com
* SVG export for sign manufacturer
* Multi-line text up to 4 lines
* Logo / image upload
* Quote mode + email notifications
* AI Design Assistant
* 10 colors + 8 fonts
* 3 sign materials

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.8+
  • WooCommerce 5.0+
  • PHP 7.4+
sections.installation:
1. Upload and activate the plugin
  2. Edit any product → check Enable Neon Sign Customizer → save
  3. Visit product page — customizer appears
sections.faq:
Does this work with any WooCommerce theme?

Yes — compatible with Storefront, Astra, OceanWP, Flatsome and all WooCommerce themes.

Can I change the currency?

Yes — Neon Sign Customizer → Settings → Currency Symbol.
